finalStaticReview.finding: The earlier implementation fetched new bytes but compared them with the old receipt, breaking refresh.
finalStaticReview.resolution: After successful JSON parsing, the importer writes the downloaded raw response and a new URL/query/time/SHA receipt. Reused cached bytes still require an exact matching receipt. No committed source was refreshed for this review.

finalStaticReview.finding: The earlier implementation required a discovery receipt that did not exist in an empty cache.
finalStaticReview.resolution: The exact pinned Overpass query is now present in the importer and sent as a POST when needed. Complete Overpass response metadata and the expected 18-district inventory are checked. The source retains all municipality faces and does not invent a nineteenth district.
finalStaticReview.supportingExecution: boundary-import-smoke.json: backend owner ran the real importer from an isolated temporary cwd with recorded responses replacing network calls, then changed response bytes and verified refresh updated receipt hashes. finalStaticReview.area: Final browser-discovered HTTP cache mode regression
finalStaticReview.finding: A normal browser reload/no-store request could bypass an existing valid CacheStorage map and receive SW 503 offline.
finalStaticReview.resolution: SW bypasses CacheStorage only for X-Vesluma-Map-Retry: 1. The loader sends that header only after a failed map load and retains cache: reload to bypass a bad HTTP cache response. First requests are unmarked. Independent rerun passed all 51 worker/loader tests, including ordinary reload/no-store offline hits and explicit invalid-map replacement. The rebuilt worker exactly matches reviewed source; the final rebuilt entry is index-CGmM-jbQ.js.

First install caches no city map. Only fully validated winning loader responses are handed off. Reload retries bypass corrupted old map/HTTP cache responses. Six-city CacheStorage mutations are serialized; index/eviction failure rolls back a new seventh copy. Decoded memory is limited to two cities. The old-v7 update window uses same-origin MessageChannel acknowledgement before transferring bytes, with a 30-second total waiting bound and controllerchange handling.

Map messages require a same-origin client and target, no query/hash, an exact current manifest asset and bounded nonempty ArrayBuffer. The 64 MiB cap includes Guangzhou's actual 54,000,983-byte decoded form. API navigation and data/photo endpoints are excluded. Old valid six-city hashes can migrate; stale hashes are removed; API bodies do not migrate.

Raw WGS84 source geometry, tourism game groups and official administrative attribution are distinguished. Shenzhen/Shenshan and Hong Kong/Macao special source faces use neutral coverage/access notes. Complete Boolean checks, rather than rounded areas or sample points, prove the selected source footprint is partitioned. The Chengdu generator text correction deliberately restores the released six-city object so regeneration preserves its fixed hash.

limits: No physical phone, field arrival, actual GPS drift, exact photograph entrance or local public-access permission was verified.
The 250 m tests validate numerical application behavior using simulated coordinates; they do not validate real-world accuracy or lawful access across a boundary.
Boundary area values include all OSM source faces and are not official land or sea-area statistics. Two-dimensional port faces do not establish legal or vertical jurisdiction.
The four supplemental street raw responses remain optional temporary research evidence; the committed-source component/intersection/Shenshan audit is independently reproducible without them.

Cross-tab eviction or manually clearing CacheStorage while a map remains in a tab's decoded memory can report a cache miss without automatically refetching that in-memory map. This edge was not browser-tested; offline availability after browser cleanup is not promised.
Cache quotas and true low-end phone or weak-network behavior remain device-dependent. Local SQLite spaces are namespaces, not production authentication or cloud synchronization.
Boundary importer smoke tests use recorded public responses and no network; they prove cold-start/request/receipt handling rather than future endpoint availability.
